## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit carries a Developer Certificate of Origin sign-off (`Signed-off-by: Name <email>`, DCO 1.1).
- [ ] Code, comments, specifications, and commit messages are in English.
- [ ] Preserves all security invariants (see [README.md](../README.md) and [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)):
  - [ ] Models propose, the Core decides: no path where a model or webview approves a consequential step.
  - [ ] Intents, surfaces, and capabilities are catalog- and schema-driven (no hardcoded keywords or phrases).
  - [ ] Training data contains no personal data, IP literals, credentials, or residency/approval/grant fields.
- [ ] Relevant checks pass (see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)).
